keyword: where to watch the oscars red carpet
claims: The 2026 Oscars red carpet is live on March 15, 2026.
The 2026 Oscars red carpet starts at 6:30 p.m. ET (3:30 p.m. PT) on ABC and Hulu.
"On The Red Carpet" pre-shows begin at 3:30 p.m. ET (12:30 p.m. PT) via ABC stations, OnTheRedCarpet.com, and YouTube.
E! Live from the Red Carpet begins at 4 p.m. ET.
Official Coverage at 6:30 p.m. ET / 3:30 p.m. PT is on ABC (Television) and Hulu (Streaming).
Alternative Coverage at 4 p.m. ET / 1 p.m. PT is "Live from E!: Oscars 2026" on E! Network and Peacock.
Peacock digital/social media coverage is on OnTheRedCarpet.com, ABC News YouTube, and Facebook.
OnTheRedCarpet.com alternative streaming is available via Live TV services including YouTube TV, Fubo, or Hulu+ Live TV.
The official 30-minute preshow leading into the ceremony begins at 6:30 p.m. ET on ABC/Hulu.
